McDonald & Dodds

4 Series 11 Feature-Length Mysteries Tala Gouveia & Jason Watkins Bath Created by Robert Murphy

Ambitious DCI Lauren McDonald arrives in Bath from London and is paired with DS Dodds, a quiet, overlooked detective whose sharp mind is easy to underestimate. Created by Robert Murphy, McDonald & Dodds ran for four series and 11 feature-length mysteries on ITV from 2020 to 2024. It streams on BritBox in the US. See how the services compare in British TV Hub's guide to where to watch British TV in the US.

New Viewer's Guide

Series 1, The Fall of the House of Crockett (2020)

The first case shows how McDonald and Dodds are first thrown together. Each mystery is self-contained, but the partnership grows from series to series, so starting at the beginning pays off.

Best Episodes, Ranked

British TV Hub's picks, spoiler-free.

#1

The Fall of the House of Crockett

A wealthy entrepreneur returns home to find a body and a valuable statue missing, and the new partnership gets its first test. It's the best introduction to the pair's contrasting styles.

At a Glance

Best ForFirst-time viewers
Where to WatchBritBox

#2

The Man Who Wasn't There

A passenger falls to his death during a hot-air balloon flight over Bath, leaving an unusual puzzle. It's a British TV Hub pick for its striking premise and use of the city.

#3

We Need to Talk About Doreen

A body is found in a railway tunnel, and the investigation leads to a group of friends on a weekend away. It balances humour and mystery especially well.

What Makes the Series Special

Partnership

An Unlikely Double Act

McDonald's confidence and Dodds's quiet, careful thinking make a classic mismatched partnership, and the growing respect between them is the heart of the show.
